name: Tuberculosis
description: A potentially serious infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis that primarily affects the lungs, characterized by persistent cough, chest pain, weight loss, and night sweats.
risk_factors: Close contact with active TB case
Travel to or residence in TB-endemic region
physical_examination: Decreased breath sounds over affected areas
recommended_investigations: Sputum smear microscopy for acid-fast bacilli (AFB)
red_flags: Signs of meningeal involvement (headache, neck stiffness)

clinical_references.title: Clinical and Laboratory Diagnosis for Tuberculosis
clinical_references.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
